task_goal: Estimate a Local Distance Network consensus Hubble constant H0 at approximately 1% precision using the provided minimal dataset.
named_method_commitments: Generalized least squares / covariance-weighted distance-network combination
Geometric anchor propagation from NGC4258, LMC/SMC-like anchor, and MW parallaxes when available in data
Primary indicators: Cepheids and TRGB in the minimal dataset (full prompt also names Miras and JAGB, but not present in this file)
Secondary indicators: SNe Ia and SBF in the minimal dataset
Hubble-flow measurements with peculiar-velocity uncertainty converted to magnitude covariance
Analysis variants and comparisons with early-universe/CMB constraints
primary_outputs: baseline H0 estimate with standard uncertainty
variant H0 estimates by indicator/anchor choices
comparison to prompt baseline H0=73.50 +/- 0.81 and Planck-like early-universe value
assumptions_to_verify_or_state: Minimal dataset is illustrative and may not exactly reproduce the prompt baseline.
SBF calibrators do not have independent primary-distance rows; a pragmatic group-distance calibration may be required.
MW anchor is listed but no MW host measurement rows are present.
